about: Sources for the rank 2-3 picks that aren't a best pick anywhere, in the BiS-page wording parse_source reads. Read from each item's ForeverDB page (https://foreverdb.net/item/<id>); the ones ForeverDB didn't know were filled from Wowhead's Forever item pages (created-by / reward-from / dropped-by, drop % = Wowhead's count/outof) in the owner's Chrome, 2026-10-12. Best picks keep their own source from raw/.
